keyQuestions: Q1: What should a realistic held-out evaluation set for system-skill-advisor look like: its size, the source of its prompts, its negatives, and how it stays held out from the prompts the scorer is tuned against?

label: Held-out set: extend the existing routing-accuracy stack - 66-row fixture-derived holdout (20 harder + 40 regression + 6 delegation) with copied labels and per-row provenance, family-normalized collision drop against the 195-row training corpus, SHA-256 pins, ratchet floors 0.75/0.725 with bucket minima 31/32/9, gold-none negatives measured as gold_none_false_fire/unknown_count, and overlap scoped against every tuning surface; the 17+5 battery is a visible-prompt smoke test, not the set.

Parity check: compare strict top-1 with abstention normalized to none/null; never raw confidence or ranks at or below second place; failure contract = the ratchet's five reviewed rules (unapproved divergence, resolved entry, recorded-field drift, duplicate ids, orphan ids) plus fail-closed on missing Python; the CLI gold-anchored harness is a smoke gate, not the parity gate.

Placement: the batched ratchet model (one Python subprocess plus in-process native calls, roughly 3.9 s warm for all 217 union rows) belongs inside the existing full-install golden-prompt-gate job; static pins belong in the lean routing-drift job; never in or behind --warn-only (always exit 0); ties at 0.82 are floor collisions resolved deterministically, so divergences are stable and ledgerable.

Measured current state: 73/73 union divergences ledgered; the ratchet-semantics replay predicts one rule-(c) review item, rr-iter3-168; 43/73 (59%) are the local-abstention class; floor-level top-1 margins can be roughly 1e-4; the vitest confirmation remains the settlement step.

Attribution narrowed: fusion.ts's last change 3a4d1a8927 is a comment/import refactor with no scoring logic; 4e69fb4d45's four removed native boosts do not occur in the entry's prompt; surviving candidates are the Oct 10-11 vocabulary/graph commits (479186cfed, 827e44abc8, regenerations); pinning one still needs a per-commit replay, out of scope read-only.

Terminal package: three in-place moves (extend the holdout and corpus-pin stack; wire the ratchet as a blocking gate in golden-prompt-gate; keep static pins in routing-drift), one standing disposition (ledger, never threshold nudge), one open review item (rr-iter3-168), two unmeasured settlement steps (vitest confirmation, CI minutes).
